about: The conformance samples of `just b3d match samples` (tools/src/beryl_tools/beryl3d/match/samples.py): each is one element of `box` points with the CSS `style` (and an optional run of `text`), centred on the `page` color, shot in WebKit and drawn by Beryl 3D's renderer. The values are those ui/src's CSS uses.

samples.about: the panel color (--surface) on the table color
